Job Information
Avya Technology Pvt. Ltd. is seeking an experienced AI Agentic Engineer / Senior AI Developer to build intelligent applications powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI workflows, and modern full-stack technologies. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Node.js, Next.js, Python, Generative AI, AI Agent Development, and enterprise application architecture. This role focuses on developing AI-powered solutions capable of reasoning, planning, tool utilization, workflow orchestration, memory management, and autonomous task execution. The successful candidate will play a key role in designing and delivering next-generation AI applications, enterprise copilots, automation platforms, and intelligent business solutions.
Key Highlights
5 8 years of professional software development experience.
Strong expertise in Node.js, Next.js, and Python.
Hands-on experience with OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, or similar LLM platforms.
Experience building AI Agents, Agentic Workflows, and Multi-Agent Systems.
Strong understanding of Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Vector Databases.
Experience with AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar technologies.
Strong knowledge of REST APIs, Microservices Architecture, and Cloud Platforms.
Familiarity with PHP and Laravel Framework is considered an advantage.
Experience building scalable enterprise-grade applications.
Experience using AI-powered development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, Claude Code, ChatGPT, and Windsurf.
Tech Stack
Core Technologies: Node.js, Next.js, Python, React.js, TypeScript, FastAPI, Django
Generative AI & LLMs: OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Claude, Gemini
AI Frameworks & Agentic AI: LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen
Vector Databases & RAG: Pinecone, ChromaDB, Weaviate
Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis
Cloud & DevOps: AWS, Azure, Docker, Git, CI/CD
AI Development Tools: GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, Claude Code, Windsurf
Good to Have: PHP, Laravel
Employment Details
Employment Type: Full time
Work Mode: Hybrid
Responsibilities
As a key member of our team, you will:
Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications and intelligent software solutions.
Build AI Agents capable of reasoning, planning, decision-making, and autonomous task execution.
Develop single-agent and multi-agent workflows for business automation use cases.
Design and optimize prompts to improve AI performance, accuracy, and reliability.
Implement advanced AI patterns such as ReAct, Planner-Executor, Tool Calling, Reflection Loops, and Agent Orchestration.
Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems using vector databases and enterprise knowledge repositories.
Integrate AI agents with APIs, databases, cloud platforms, and enterprise systems.
Build modern and responsive web applications using Next.js and React.js.
Develop scalable backend services using Python and Node.js.
Design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs and microservices.
Skills & Abilities
Must-Have Skills
Minimum 5+ years of software development experience.
Strong expertise in Node.js, Next.js, and Python.
Hands-on experience integrating OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Azure OpenAI, or similar LLM platforms.
Experience building AI-powered applications, AI Agents, and intelligent automation solutions.
Strong understanding of Prompt Engineering and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Experience implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
Experience with Vector Databases such as Pinecone, ChromaDB, Weaviate, FAISS, or Milvus.
Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or similar frameworks.
Strong understanding of REST APIs, Microservices, and Cloud-based architectures.
Experience with AWS, Azure, Docker, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.
Familiarity with GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, Claude Code, ChatGPT, and AI-assisted development tools.
Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Good-to-Have Skills
PHP and Laravel Framework.
Multi-Agent Coordination and Agent Orchestration.
MCP (Model Context Protocol).
Kubernetes and Container Orchestration.
SaaS Product Development.
Enterprise Software Architecture and System Design.
AI Safety, Hallucination Mitigation, and Responsible AI practices.
MLOps concepts and AI deployment pipelines.
Experience integrating CRM, ERP, HRMS, or business applications with AI solutions.
Elasticsearch and advanced search technologies.
Soft Skills
Strong analytical and critical-thinking abilities.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Leadership and mentoring capabilities.
Ownership mindset and accountability.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
Passion for innovation and continuous learning.
Strong focus on quality, performance, and customer success.
Assessment Criteria: You will be evaluated on technical depth, system design thinking, coding best practices, and cultural fit.
Interview Process
Application Review: Screening profiles matching role requirements (1-3 days)
Hr Screening: Introductory discussion about experience and fit (20-30 mins)
Technical Assessment: Evaluate technical expertise (30-60 mins)
